decisions.reason: Connects plugin/lib/client.js's top-level import with the host-boot-log classic-script combo and the browser-error compile failure: parse is all-or-nothing so zero entries register, and dsh-typert-registry is only the first awaited entry, not the faulty bundle. Correctly scopes the ESM restriction to classic scripts rather than all JavaScript.

Recommends bisecting the cordis.patch.yml insert rows (removing the dsh-profiles row isolates the culprit) and a per-bundle parse-as-classic-script check (equivalent to vm.Script). Describes the ModuleLoader.load({id, factory}) wrapper with package-name identity, host-provided React via require inside the factory, and inject/apply exports, matching the working-plugin excerpt.

Correctly uses plugin-apply-error.txt to explain that the settings parent entry owns the declaration, apply ordering is not guaranteed, and registrants must not set kind/scope. However, it never shows or describe the required deferred form ctx.slots.inject("settings.section", () => ctx.slots.register(...)); instead it invents an immediate ctx.slots.register(parentSlot, ...) form unsupported by the sealed facts, and wrongly claims the registrant must not pass name (rubric says registrants supply name/id/order).

Grounded in host-boot-log.txt and restart-notes.txt: combo assembled once per boot so edits and browser refresh do not rebuild it; full stop/restart per iteration; EADDRINUSE explained as the orphaned old process retaining the port, resolved via taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F; then refresh and verify the plugin list.

Host-side advice is solid: per-plugin classic-script validation before concatenation and culprit attribution by byte-range at combo failure instead of blaming the first awaited entry. The authoring checklist covers loader factory, host React via require, inject/apply, install rows, and restart/Windows tree cleanup, but its slot item lacks the deferred cross-entry slots.inject registration form required by the checklist.

caps.reason: In its affirmative recommended registration form (section 3 and checklist item 4) the report omits the child-side slots.inject deferral and recommends immediate cross-entry registration via ctx.slots.register(parentSlot, ...) inside apply, contradicting the deferred-registration contract that apply ordering is not guaranteed.
